resources.string: When a chat model cannot see images, images are never sent to it. With this on, a small vision model describes each image in text first and the description is given to the chat model. The image stays in the chat.
No local server with a vision model (model plus mmproj) found. Create one in Servers first.
Pick a local vision server to enable the helper.
A temporary low-impact server starts only when there is enough free RAM, describes all pending images in one run and is stopped again.
